note: The falsifier roster: every row of the census, its anchor, and each pin with its page's digest (sha256/16) and the claim words its page falsifies. The census holds its rows, their pins and each pin's page to this file, in order.

the same let with a literal initializer still reads <opaque MODULE:let>: a let never reads its initializer
control S1c: the let renamed LOADED (no shadowed const) reads <opaque LOADED:let>
the shadowed module-level const, read outside the let's scope, resolves to "node:fs"
refusal #3's S2 plant: a parameter shadowing a same-file const, loaded through a same-file createRequire helper, reads <opaque SPECIFIER:parameter>
control: the parameter renamed REQUESTED reads <opaque REQUESTED:parameter>
the shadowed const, read outside the parameter's function, resolves to "node:path"
refusal #3's S3 plant: a registration's effectClass held by a let that shadows a same-file const reads <opaque EFFECT_CLASS:let>
control S3c: the same let with no shadowed const reads the same
a registration outside the let's scope reads the const's read
a const shadowing a const reads its own text inside its scope and the outer one's outside it: no over-report
a let shadowing a const reads opaque inside its scope: no under-report
a parameter shadowing a const reads opaque inside its function: no under-report
the census header's claim paragraph is BINDING_TEXT_CLAIM byte-for-byte
the claim rows are exactly the claim's parts, in order
the export rows are the export's title, description items and Acceptance line, verbatim
each MEMBERS entry (R-B115's eight and refusal #1's G01 to G10) is a pin of its part's row
the kinds row holds one K- pin per kind the kinds part names, in the claim's order, then the kinds part's MEMBERS (G01, G08, G09), in order
every row's pins, in order, are this roster's, each page at the digest this roster names
by scope: a block const shadowing a const reads its own text, the outer reads outside, and a function's later const binds its earlier reference
a shorthand property's name reads through its value's binding: the const registers, the parameter does not
O:1399 U1(c) member a10: a const with an unresolvable initializer shadowing a resolvable same-named const reads opaque, not the outer text
a module, exported, for-statement and chained const each resolve through their initializers

an element of a destructuring pattern never resolves, even with a default: const object and array pattern elements and a let pattern element, each with a default, read <opaque NAME:destructuring>, never the default's text
import: named (twice, merged), import-equals, namespace, default, and an import merged with a namespace
unbound: a global, a missing name, a type alias and an interface in value position, and the lib names String, undefined and globalThis (no lib)

merged: a redeclared var, a const merged with a type, function overloads, a var destructuring element declared twice (merged before destructuring) and a namespace declared in two blocks (merged before namespace)

destructuring before the declaring kinds: a parameter pattern's element, const object and array pattern elements (one with a default), let and var object pattern elements, a catch clause pattern's element and a for-of head pattern's element all read destructuring
let: with and without an initializer, a declare let (let, not ambient) and a let exported from a namespace body (let, not namespace)
var: at module and function level, a declare var (var, not ambient) and a var exported from a namespace body (var, not namespace)
using: a using and an await using declaration
catch: a catch clause variable

no-initializer: for-of and for-in consts, a declare const with no initializer (before ambient), a const with no initializer exported from a namespace body (before namespace) and one exported from a declare namespace, read from a merged namespace block (before both)

ambient: a declare const, a const in a declare global block, and a const exported from a namespace nested in a declare namespace (ambient through an outer declare, read from a merged dotted namespace block)
namespace: a const exported from a namespace body (two merged blocks), and the namespace itself; an unexported namespace const resolves
parameter: a function parameter, a constructor parameter property, a defaulted arrow parameter and a rest parameter
function: a function declaration (plain, async, generator, declare - not ambient - and one exported from a namespace body - not namespace) and a named function expression's own name
class: a class declaration (plain, declare - not ambient - and one exported from a namespace body - not namespace) and a named class expression's own name
enum: an enum member read inside its enum, the enum, a const enum, a declare enum (not ambient) and an enum exported from a namespace body (not namespace)
other: a declaration of any other kind (a synthetic type alias)

refusal #1 U1a member g01 (the ambient and namespace checks swapped): its twin page t01a, a const exported from a declare namespace read in a merged namespace block, reads <opaque X:ambient> (ambient before namespace), never <opaque X:namespace>
refusal #1 U1h member g08 (declare let and declare var read ambient): its twin page t08 reads <opaque X:let> and <opaque Y:var>; ambient names only a const

refusal #1 U1i member g09 (a let or var exported from a namespace body reads namespace): its twin page t09 reads <opaque X:let> and <opaque Y:var>; namespace names only a const exported from a namespace body
a script's with body reads <opaque X:with> for a const; the with's object and code outside it resolve
the same in a .ts module

refusal #1 U1b member g02 (the with-body walk stops at a function): its twin page t02.js, an identifier inside an arrow function inside a with body, reads <opaque X:with>, and the same identifier outside the with resolves

at any depth of a with body (a script): inside a function declaration, a function expression, a class method, an object method, a with whose body is no block, a nested with, nested blocks and a with inside a function the const reads <opaque X:with>; whatever it binds: a let, an unbound name and a const declared inside the body read with; outside every with the const resolves
a module calling eval by name reads every identifier as <opaque X:eval>
eval through parentheses, as, satisfies, a non-null ! and a type assertion still counts
eval through await still counts
eval wins over a with body
control: globalThis.eval, (0, eval), an alias of eval, new eval(...) and the tagged template eval`1` are no call by name, so the const resolves
refusal #1 U1c member g03 (an optional call is not counted): its twin page t03, whose only eval call is eval?.("1"), reads <opaque X:eval>
a call of eval with no argument, inside a class method, counts, whatever each identifier binds: a parameter, a const, a let, an import and an unbound name each read <opaque NAME:eval>
eval called through a local binding named eval (a sloppy script's parameter) is still a call of the identifier eval: the module's const reads <opaque X:eval>
two consts reaching each other read <opaque A:cycle> at the repeated reach
a const reaching itself through a + join and a template reads <opaque NAME:cycle>

refusal #1 U1d member g04 (NAME taken from the first const reached): its twin page t04, A reaching B, B reaching C, C reaching B, reads <opaque B:cycle> - the identifier at the repeated reach, not the probed A
the same declaration, not a same-named one: an inner const N reached through M to the outer const N reads the outer's text, no cycle
the expression's other alternatives read as usual: a const whose true branch reaches itself reads <opaque C:cycle> | "z"
double-quoted, single-quoted and no-substitution template literals read their texts
each escape sequence reads as its character: \x41 in a double-quoted, \x42 in a single-quoted and \x43 in a no-substitution template literal read A, B and C
a const identifier reads its text and a let reads opaque
a template reads every combination of its parts, in order
a template's literal parts read with their escapes (\x43 and \x44 around a const substitution read ChD), and two varying substitutions combine in order, the first varying slowest
a + join reads every combination of its sides
both branches are read and the condition is not
both sides of ?? are read, an opaque left side included
both sides of || are read
both sides of && are read
parentheses, as, satisfies, a non-null !, a type assertion and await read through
a call, property and element accesses, a number, a tagged template and an assignment read opaque, whitespace runs as one space

each of these reads one <opaque TEXT>: a comma expression, the compound assignments +=, ||=, ??= and &&=, the binary operators - and ===, void, typeof, a prefix !, a postfix ++, delete, an instantiation expression, an optional property access, an optional element access, an optional call, a new expression, null, true, false, this, a bigint, a regular expression, an arrow function, an object literal and an array literal
a combination with opaque parts reads as its first opaque part

refusal #1 U1j member g10 (a join collapsed to its first opaque part when any combination holds one): its twin page t10, a template and a + join over (c ? p : "x"), each reads <opaque p:parameter> | "x/bin" - the exact combination stays

per combination: (c ? "x" : p) + (c ? f() : "y") reads <opaque f()> | "xy" | <opaque p:parameter>: each combination's first opaque part, the text-only combination joined, each once, in combination order

64 combinations read and 128 bound, for a + join and for a template of two-way conditionals; 16 levels read and 17 bound for nested parentheses, an identifier chain (I15 and I16), a left-nested ?? chain, nested false branches and nested template substitutions
refusal #1 U1e member g05 (+ sides count no level): its twin page t05, an 18-term + chain, reads <opaque "a":bound>
refusal #1 U1f member g06 (|| and && sides count no level): its twin page t06, 18-term || and && chains of parameters, reads p0 and p1 bound and p2 to p17 as parameters, for each chain
refusal #1 U1g member g07 (only parentheses count a wrapper level): its twin page t07, "a" under 17 as string wrappers, reads <opaque "a":bound>

more than 64 combinations, counted before any two read alike: a + join and a template of 5 x 13 alternatives (65 combinations, 17 distinct texts) read bound, and of 8 x 8 (64 combinations) read all 64 texts
each wrapper counts exactly one level: parentheses, as, satisfies, a non-null !, a type assertion and await around I14 read "i" and around I15 bound, beside I14 and I15 read alone ("i")
each side counts exactly one level: the left and the right side of +, ??, || and && holding I14 read and holding I15 bound
each branch counts exactly one level: the true and the false branch of ?: holding I14 read and holding I15 bound
each substitution counts exactly one level: a template's first and a later substitution holding I14 read and holding I15 bound
alternatives are in source order, a true branch's and a left side's first, combinations by their parts, each once
texts are read when no alternative is opaque, and are unresolved otherwise
words split at whitespace, quotes and shell operators, base names with .exe and .cmd dropped in either case, each once, and unresolved for an opaque alternative
